package.name: inmoov_description
package.description: InMoov robot model (URDF xacro + meshes + self-collision SRDF, estimated mass/inertia) for RViz2 comparison against the physical robot. Generated via LinkForge from a Blender model derived from InMoov (Gael Langevin) through a fork of https://github.com/Sentience-Robotics/inmoov_urdf. Code is GPL-3.0; the meshes and the .blend source are CC BY-NC 4.0 (see LICENSE-ASSETS.md). The robot itself is driven via inmoov_control, not ros2_control.
